gen-almendra-display-gf-changa: Storybook flourish meets sturdy modern lettering. Almendra Display handles the ornate, literary flourish best, while Changa puts its weight into a lowercase as stout as cast iron capitals.
gen-almendra-display-gf-days-one: Almendra Display has letters that never seem to pinch shut, giving it a literary, ornate face. Days One follows in a neutral, approachable sans whose tall lowercase fills the line and whose spacing steps along like rungs on a ladder.
gen-almendra-display-gf-epunda-sans: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary hand with a pronounced x-height. Epunda Sans keeps long reading easy, its oversized e and a counters leaving daylight inside every curve while trimmed sidebearings hold the lines together.
gen-almendra-display-gf-farro: Farro is approachable and compressed, with short ascenders and no stroke contrast. Almendra Display brings low-contrast pen pressure and ornate swagger, while Farro runs on in a plain sans that reads smoothly and steadily over many lines.
gen-almendra-display-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono reads structured and precise, each letter set like a nail on a ruler. Almendra Display adds ornate, literary curves above it, so the page has a loose, bookish top and a tidy monospace body with a tall waist line.
gen-almendra-display-gf-geist-mono: Geist Mono reads like code, fixed-width with a lowercase that rises high. Almendra Display does ornate, literary character best, while Geist Mono does the structured, technical job, cut like laser sheet with one stroke width.
gen-almendra-display-gf-genos: Almendra Display has letters that never pinch shut, ornate and literary in feel. Genos is a contemporary plain sans with glyphs pressed close and a high midline, and that quiet, brush-light restraint is what makes the pair work.
gen-almendra-display-gf-geom: Geom reads contemporary and approachable, with a lofty lowercase band. Almendra Display does ornate, literary flourish best, while Geom does open, friendly sans-serif text best.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hammersmith-one: Almendra Display sets an ornate, literary tone with a pronounced x-height and open letterforms. Hammersmith One brings true monoline strokes like cut lengths of cord, with capitals barely taller than lowercase, and that sturdy, rounded sans is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-inder: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display opens with a pronounced x-height. Inder brings a professional, clean sans-serif with little height difference between cases, but a slightly generous size lets its small capitals breathe.
